items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: So they came on and they got married and we stood up for them.

ctx.x: So when Al Killian and his wife, they were getting ready to get married, and they wanted to go to Indiana. So they came on and they got married and we stood up for them. And he was asking Mama something about being her son-in-law and she said, 'well I can't help you out there. You got to ask her'. So that was that. I didn't want him for no husband. He was nice as a boyfriend, you know, just being around. Kept me from being lonesome sometimes.
Yeah. I mean, the life that they were leading, they just didn't make very good husbands, did they? Let me see how far along I am.
